ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Dominantly low-intensity (black) across >90% of the visible area; high-intensity (white) pixels are localized in dense clusters at the distal tips and as sparse mottling in the medial-upper quadrants.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous low-intensity black zone across central and inner lobe areas. High-contrast geometric white clusters are located at the left and right distal tips. Minimal stochastic white punctate marks are visible in the upper-medial regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 32 degrees and a high depth-to-width ratio.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serrations; pixel-amplitude of variations is highest (approx. 10-15 pixels) at the outer thirds of the trailing edge, becoming lower frequency and smoother approaching the median notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex leading edge sweep transitioning to an irregular, jagged trailing edge that terminates in pointed, encrusted tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Concentrated clusters of roughly circular high-contrast pixel groups located at both the far left and far right distal tips, corresponding to heavy colonization areas.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of several fine, diagonal white linear pixel disruptions (rake-like marks) on the medial surface of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive structural irregularities and calcified-appearing growths at the lateral margins of both lobes, resulting in a jagged, high-contrast distal profile.
